title: Predicting Multi-View Rashomon Representation: Can We Learn Where Models Disagree?
abstract: arXiv:2609.39848v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly adopted across a wide range of applications, often serving as core blocks within AI systems. Yet different foundation models may encode the same input from multiple different views, leading to substantial representation disagreement, which we term Rashomon Representation. Such disagreement often signals inputs that a given model encodes in a way inconsistent with other models, offering a valuable yet underexplored signal for input reliability estimation. While prior work has largely focused on measuring disagreement across multiple models with a representation set, we instead focus on predicting disagreement from a single representation. translated_title: 预测多视角罗生门表示：我们能学会模型在哪里产生分歧吗？
translated_abstract: 基础模型正日益被广泛应用于各类场景，常常作为AI系统中的核心组件。然而，不同的基础模型可能从多个不同的视角对同一输入进行编码，从而导致显著的表示分歧，我们将这种现象称为“罗生门表示”。这种分歧通常表明某个模型对输入的编码方式与其他模型不一致，为输入可靠性估计提供了一个有价值但尚未被充分探索的信号。先前的工作主要集中在通过表示集合来测量多个模型之间的分歧，而我们则专注于从单一表示出发预测分歧。我们假设这种分歧遵循某种一致的、依赖于输入的模式，而非随机发生。为了验证这一假设，我们通过比较每个样本在不同模型表示空间中的最近邻来量化分歧，然后训练一个轻量级模型来进行预测。
tldr: 该论文提出“罗生门表示”概念，发现不同基础模型对同一输入的表示分歧遵循一致的、依赖输入的可预测模式，可通过单一表示训练轻量级模型来预测模型间分歧，为输入可靠性估计提供了新途径。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "Rashomon Representation" and demonstrates that representation disagreement across foundation models follows consistent, input-dependent patterns, enabling prediction of such disagreement from a single representation using a lightweight model—a valuable new signal for input reliability estimation.
